mapper.insert: insert into calendar (calendar_id, calendar_title, calendar_description, calendar_start_date, calendar_end_date,calendar_status,calendar_photo) values (#{calendar_id}, #{calendar_title}, #{calendar_description}, #{calendar_start_date}, #{calendar_end_date},#{calendar_status},#{calendar_photo} )
mapper.update: update calendar set calendar_title = #{calendar_title}, calendar_description = #{calendar_description}, calendar_start_date = #{calendar_start_date}, calendar_end_date = #{calendar_end_date}, calendar_status = #{calendar_status}, calendar_photo = #{calendar_photo} where calendar_id = #{calendar_id}
